name: What are the common property taxes for waterfront homes in Miami-Dade County?

mainEntity.name: What are the common property taxes for waterfront homes in Miami-Dade County?

acceptedAnswer.text: Property taxes for waterfront homes in Miami-Dade County are calculated based on the assessed value of the property and the applicable millage rates set by various taxing authorities, including the county, city, and school board. Waterfront properties, given their higher market values, will generally incur higher property tax liabilities than comparable inland properties. As a first-party insight, Kelby Contreras can provide an estimated property tax figure based on the most recent tax assessments for specific properties you are considering, as part of the due diligence process. This ensures you have a clear understanding of the ongoing costs associated with your potential waterfront investment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Property taxes for waterfront homes in Miami-Dade County are based on assessed value and millage rates, typically higher due to elevated property values.
